prompt: Name a Monopoly property named after a US state.

answers.name: Illinois Avenue
answers.fact: Statistically the most landed-on property in the game.

answers.name: Pennsylvania Avenue
answers.fact: Part of the green group, and the priciest set before the dark blues.

answers.name: New York Avenue
answers.fact: Completes the orange set, the most landed-on group after leaving jail.

answers.name: Connecticut Avenue
answers.fact: The last of the light blues.

answers.name: Tennessee Avenue
answers.fact: The middle orange, and one of the shrewdest buys in the game.

answers.name: Virginia Avenue
answers.fact: The last of the pink group.

answers.name: Kentucky Avenue
answers.fact: The first red property after Free Parking.

answers.name: Indiana Avenue
answers.fact: The middle red, easy to forget and easy to land on.
